Definition: from G1909 and G507; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.):--above, more than, (up-)on, over.
BiblicalUsage: Epano means up above, over, on top of — a small word that sets the height of things. A city set on a hill cannot be hid, the charge against Jesus was set up over his head, and the one who comes from above is above all. It marks rank as much as place: who stands over whom, and what sits above what.
TheologicalSignificance: What comes from above carries authority over what comes from below, and that is why John's words about Christ land with such weight. He is above all because He is from above, and I believe that settles where my trust should rest.
RelatedEvents: The Crucifixion; Jesus Calms the Storm
